signal_family_note: Host signal is the shipped strategy_params.json bb_rsi window. bb_rsi was later null-killed as a search family. This overlay does not revive it.

host.exits: Host ATR SL/TP and RSI soft exit unchanged. Overlay changes lots only.

holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection; evaluate once after develop pick

costs.slippage_notes: UNMEASURED. Not a claim of zero slip. Official comparison uses this book. Assumed-slip sensitivity is labeled and not used to pick.

model.name: GARCH(1,1)
model.info_set: returns strictly before the signal bar (through r[i-1])

size_map.name: target_risk_invvol
size_map.sideline_note: lot=0 if forecast sigma_return > expanding 95th percentile of past forecasts (past only). Risk, not a direction filter.

score.garch_beats_atr: develop PF_garch > PF_atr OR (PF equal and NP_garch > NP_atr)
score.n_note: host develop n=42 is thin; do not celebrate small-n PF

do_not: fit GARCH once on full develop and apply backward
reopen GoldSessionScalp or the M5 defined-R grid
